downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Find a track in the catalog or paste a link - LFMusic picks the best source and adds cover art, tags and lyrics

tips.searchText: Titles, artists and albums from Deezer - with cover art and exact durations
tips.linkText: YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and hundreds of other sites, playlists included
tips.albumText: Open an album or artist and grab everything with one click

downloads.emptyNothingDesc: Check the spelling or add the artist name
downloads.searchError: Search failed - check your internet connection

setup.title: Let's set up the downloader
setup.text: Downloading needs yt-dlp and the Deno engine; ffmpeg helps with rare formats. Everything goes into the app folder from the official GitHub releases.
setup.denoText: YouTube won't serve audio without it. Installing takes under a minute.
setup.confirmText: yt-dlp, Deno and ffmpeg will be downloaded from their official GitHub repositories and verified by checksum.
setup.updateTitle: A new yt-dlp version is out
setup.updateText: YouTube changes often - the latest version downloads more reliably.

errors.not_found: No matching recording found - try pasting a link
errors.bot_check: YouTube wants to confirm you're not a bot - set up cookies in settings
errors.cookies: Couldn't read cookies - close the browser or pick another one
errors.auth_required: Age-restricted video - account cookies are needed
errors.unavailable: The recording is unavailable or removed
errors.rate_limited: The site is rate limiting - retry in a couple of minutes
errors.network: No connection - check your internet or proxy
errors.outdated: yt-dlp is outdated - update the components
errors.disk: Couldn't write the file - check free disk space
errors.import: Downloaded, but not added to the library

queue.title: Downloads
queue.empty: Tracks you download show up here

downloads.redownloadText: “{title}” is already in your library. Download it again?
downloads.popularRedownloadText: The most popular tracks are already in your library. Download them again?

folder.desc: Downloaded tracks are saved here; the folder is added to the library automatically.
folder.resetTooltip: Go back to the standard “LFMusic Downloads” folder inside your Music folder
folder.fallback: Couldn't use the chosen folder - reverted to the default one.

tools.desc: yt-dlp downloads audio, Deno lets it handle YouTube, ffmpeg converts rare formats.
tools.removeTooltip: Removes only copies downloaded by the app
tools.autoUpdateDesc: Once a day, check for new yt-dlp and Deno versions before downloading

cookies.desc: Optional. Only needed when YouTube asks to confirm you're not a bot, or for age-restricted videos.
cookies.browserHint: Sign in to YouTube in the chosen browser. Chrome and Edge on Windows encrypt cookies - Firefox works most reliably.
cookies.fileHint: A Netscape-format cookies.txt (exported by extensions like “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY”).

proxy.desc: Which proxy yt-dlp uses to reach sites.
proxy.systemHint: Uses the system proxy or environment variables.
proxy.noneHint: Direct connection, system settings are ignored.
proxy.customHint: Proxy address: socks5://, http:// or https://.
proxy.invalidUrl: Invalid address - include the scheme: socks5://, http:// or https://

downloads.vpnNote: In some countries YouTube is unreachable without a VPN or proxy - downloads then fall back to SoundCloud automatically.
